title: Sent Back from Aphek
reflectionText: Achish found no fault in David, yet the princes of the Philistines would not let him go down with them to battle. David asked, “But what have I done?” So David rose up early with his men to return into the land of the Philistines. When you are sent back from the way before you, how do you go?
editorialNotes: Packet 030 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 1 Samuel 29:1-11 and ends with David’s departure and the Philistines going up to Jezreel in verse 11.
